description: This alpine bird changes plumage color with the seasons to remain hidden in snowy terrain. It survives freezing mountain climates by sheltering among rocks and dense snow cover.

name: White-tailed Ptarmigan

description: This large pigeon is commonly seen feeding in open woodlands and urban parks throughout its range. Its strong wings produce a loud clapping sound during sudden takeoff.
moves: Wing Tap,Seed Peck,Quick Glide,Soft Coo
name: Common Wood Pidgeon

description: This beautifully patterned quail prefers grassy mountain slopes with thick ground vegetation for cover. It scratches through soil and leaf litter while searching for bulbs and insects.
moves: Dust Burst,Ground Peck,Quick Hop,Wing Strike
name: Montezuma Quail
